description: This file defines the LoanProductCreditAllocationRuleMerger class, which handles updating and merging credit allocation rules for loan products within the Fineract project. It provides methods to update rules based on new input, identify differences, and merge rule details.

classes.name: LoanProductCreditAllocationRuleMerger
classes.description: A utility class responsible for merging and updating credit allocation rules associated with loan products. It provides methods to update rules with new data and merge existing rules, ensuring consistency.

methods.name: updateCreditAllocationRules
methods.description: Updates the credit allocation rules for a given loan product based on a new list of rules. It adds, removes, or merges rules and returns true if any changes were made.

methods.name: mergeLoanProductCreditAllocationRule
methods.description: Merges properties of two credit allocation rule objects, updating the target if differences are found, and indicating if a change occurred.
